hooks.command: node -e "(async()=>{const path=require('node:path');const arg=process.argv[1]||'';const root=process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT||(arg.includes('{CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}')?'':arg);if(root){await import(require('node:url').pathToFileURL(path.join(root,'hooks','always-on.mjs')).href);return}const dir=process.env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR||path.join(require('node:os').homedir(),'.claude');if(require('node:fs').existsSync(path.join(dir,'.laconic-always')))console.error('laconic: always-on is on, but the SessionStart hook got no plugin root (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT), so the ruleset was not loaded this session.')})().catch(()=>{})" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
